summary.intent: Apply a consolidated batch of seven review fixes to PR #640 (setup-callisto installer, docs, changeset, tests) in an existing worktree, add shell tests for version normalisation and download-error handling, run the full gate and review checklist, and commit locally (signed) without pushing.
summary.outcome: All seven fixes were applied plus extra doc/action.yml description updates, new shell tests were added, the full gate was rerun and reported all exit codes 0, and a signed local commit was made. The final report of sha, per-gate exit codes and checklist lines was not shown in the transcript, and nothing was pushed.

repo: Gate for this repo is `just pre-push && just lint && just doc-check && just test`, plus the setup-callisto shell tests and `just workflow-contracts`; tests elsewhere read scripts, specs and error registries so workspace-wide runs are required.

setup-callisto shell tests live in .github/actions/setup-callisto/tests/ and stub curl/gh/tar/unzip as shell functions; `testing/check-comments.sh` rejects comments that narrate history (e.g. 'removed', 'no longer').

The `version` input is described in both .github/actions/setup-callisto/action.yml and .github/actions/callisto-action/action.yml and documented in docs/architecture/release.md, so changing accepted values requires updating all three (sibling call sites).
Docs copy-paste blocks in docs/install-in-ci.md should be wrapped in a subshell `( set -euo pipefail ... )` so a failure stops extraction without closing the user's terminal.

code.finding: Download error now distinguishes HTTP 404 ('no prebuilt callisto asset') from other failures after curl retries ('download failed ... retry the job') by capturing `-w '%{http_code}'` from curl.
Comment narrating history was rewritten to describe current behaviour so check-comments passes.
Test red_c3_installer_derives_crate_version_from_the_current_tag_template was removed; it read the deleted CRATE_VERSION line, and the unused `Path` import was dropped.

friction: The initial Python-edit for the `for bad` test list had quoting problems with the `$'0.21.0\nx'` literal and needed sed and manual Edit fixes.
The doc-block proof script's awk/sed quoting broke and needed several rewrites, partly due to macOS vs GNU sed differences (`sed -i ''`).
Late doc edits invalidated an in-progress gate run, so it was stopped and restarted; checking for leftover processes was noisy because other worktrees' cargo processes were running.
A `[[ ... ]] && TAG_NAME=...` one-liner had to be rewritten as an if block (likely set -e safety).
open_items: Lead must read the diff and approve before pushing; push, merge of latest origin/main, ls-remote check, trail link and `entire trail ci-pr` are still pending.
Final report to lead (PR, sha, gate exit codes, checklist lines including item 11) still needs to be delivered.
Findings from Entire review were not to be resolved in this batch.
